system.description:
Strips of sealing paper embedded with chakra-disrupting formulae designed to interfere with a target's ability to channel jutsu mid-combat.

Applying the Tag. As an action, you can apply a Chakra Suppression Tag to a willing creature automatically. Against an unwilling creature, make an unarmed attack or a ranged weapon attack roll (range 20/60 ft). On a hit the tag adheres to the target and they must make a Charisma saving throw (DC 19). On a failed save the suppression activates. On a successful save the tag is destroyed with no effect.

Suppression Effect. While the tag is active the target cannot cast Ninjutsu or Genjutsu of any rank lower than A-Rank. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

Removing the Tag. While suppressed, the target may spend an action to make a Charisma saving throw (DC 19). On a success they break the seal's hold and the effect ends. Another creature within 5 feet may spend an action to remove the tag automatically, immediately ending the effect.

Roll the attack yourself, then use the save button; on a failure, target the creature and use Suppression activates. The cast dialog then refuses the blocked jutsu.
